reception: The preprint's citation record is small and entirely peripheral. Such engagement as exists comes from work on estimating the correctness of generated code: papers on ensemble-based uncertainty estimation and on predicting program correctness by ensemble semantic entropy discuss the clustering approach in some detail, a paper on semantic collapse in coding models cites it as an example, and a study of optimal reasoning length for RL-trained language models takes up one of its ideas. Evaluations of hallucination in generative AI systems mention it in passing. This is reception at the registration stage: the method is noticed and named rather than built on.
